The practical exposure was exceptional. Every Saturday, I observed live classroom sessions, gaining firsthand insights into teaching methodologies, classroom management, learner engagement, and effective pedagogy. These observations helped bridge the gap between theory and practice.

Another enriching component of the program was the reading and reflection of books by authors such as James Clear, Brianna Wiest, and Darius Foroux. These works encouraged self-reflection, continuous improvement, and the mindset of a lifelong learner.

Perhaps the most profound lesson was understanding the transition from trainer to mentor.

Annete ma'am is an exceptional coach, mentor, and educator.  She has a unique ability to bring out the best in her learners and inspire them to strive for excellence.

I am deeply grateful to Empower English Academy and Annete ma'am for this incredible learning journey. The program has enriched me both professionally and personally, and I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking to become a skilled trainer, communicator, leader, and lifelong learner.
